topicalProductDatabase.description: TOPICAL_DATABASE — 14 products with matching tags, scalp compatibility, gender, contraindications and mechanism data

products.name: Minoxidil 5%
products.usage: Apply once daily to the affected scalp area as directed by the doctor.
products.note: Growth active for pattern thinning; avoid for female patients during pregnancy or conception planning

products.name: Minoxidil 2% + Finasteride 0.25% Topical
products.usage: Apply at night on thinning zones only under doctor supervision.
products.note: Doctor-choice topical for androgen-sensitive thinning; avoid in pregnancy or conception planning

products.name: Minoxidil + Spironolactone Topical
products.usage: Use only if prescribed for PCOS or androgen-linked female thinning.
products.note: Avoid during pregnancy or conception planning

products.name: Ketoconazole Lotion / Shampoo
products.usage: Use twice weekly; keep contact for 3-5 minutes before rinsing unless advised otherwise.
products.note: Effective for Malassezia-driven dandruff, itching and oily scalp inflammation

products.name: Ketoconazole + Growth Serum Combo
products.usage: Use ketoconazole twice weekly and a non-irritating growth serum on alternate nights.
products.note: Best fit when dandruff and hairfall are both active

products.name: F-Emugrow MCRD
products.usage: Apply to the affected scalp area as directed by the doctor. Massage gently for 2–3 minutes. Do not rinse. Use once daily or as prescribed.
products.note: Suitable for pattern hair loss, thinning, and post-hair transplant care. Avoid in pregnancy or planning to conceive.
products.ingredients: Emu Oil · Redensyl 3% · Dutasteride 0.5% · Clove Oil · Caffeine · Zinc Oxide · Copper Tripeptide · Magnesium Oxide · Melatonin
products.mechanism: Dutasteride (0.5%) inhibits both Type I and Type II 5-alpha reductase — blocking DHT conversion more completely than Finasteride alone. Redensyl (3%) activates hair follicle stem cells and dermal papilla cell proliferation (anagen re-entry). Emu Oil improves dermal penetration of all co-delivered actives. Copper Tripeptide + Caffeine stimulate follicle microcirculation. Melatonin prolongs the anagen growth phase.

products.name: Trichogain Serum
products.usage: Apply once daily or on alternate nights to thinning areas as tolerated.
products.note: Non-minoxidil option for sensitive or dry scalp

products.name: CR Serum
products.usage: Apply on alternate nights unless the doctor changes frequency.
products.note: Gentler topical support when harsh actives are not preferred

products.name: F-Trichosure Pro
products.usage: Apply as prescribed for female hormonal thinning support.
products.note: Useful in peri-menopause, menopause or post-menopause related thinning

products.name: Premature Greying Topical Support
products.usage: Use as directed on scalp or hair roots; pair with the prescribed greying kit.
products.note: Topical support for early greying concerns

products.name: F-Trichosilk D&F (Without Treatment)
products.usage: Apply a small amount to damp or dry hair from mid-length to ends. Do not rinse. Use daily or as recommended by the doctor.
products.note: Leave-in serum for dry and frizzy hair. Keeps frizz in check, prevents knots and tangles, hydrates the hair. Light and non-greasy formula. Recommended for everyday use.
products.ingredients: Light leave-in serum complex; moisture-protective, anti-frizz, shine-enhancing. Non-greasy formula for dry and frizzy hair without heat or chemical treatment history.
products.mechanism: Hydrates and coats hair shaft. Anti-frizz, moisture-protection and shine-enhancing. No active pharmaceutical ingredient.

products.name: F-Trichosilk D&F (With Treatment)
products.usage: Apply a small amount to damp or dry hair from mid-length to ends. Do not rinse. Use daily as a heat protectant before styling or as a finishing serum.
products.note: Leave-in serum for treated and damaged hair. Boosts moisture and repairs hair fibres. Prevents dryness and frizziness. Heat protectant.
products.ingredients: Leave-in serum with heat protectant complex; moisture-boosting, fibre-repair, anti-frizz, shine and bounce enhancing. For chemically treated or heat-damaged hair.
products.mechanism: Heat protectant shield. Fibre repair, moisture retention, anti-frizz. No active pharmaceutical ingredient.

products.name: F-Biwash+ Anti-Dandruff Shampoo
products.usage: Use 2–3 times per week on wash days. Apply to wet scalp, lather gently for 3–5 minutes, then rinse thoroughly. Doctor to confirm frequency based on severity.
products.note: Medicated anti-dandruff shampoo — reduces visible flakes, relieves itching, improves scalp hygiene. Effective in treatment of Dandruff and Seborrheic Dermatitis.
products.ingredients: Medicated anti-dandruff complex; formulated to manage dandruff, scalp flaking, and itching. Gently cleanses while controlling dandruff-causing factors.
products.mechanism: Antimicrobial and antifungal scalp cleansing. Controls Malassezia-driven dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis.

products.name: Trichonourish EVA / FHA-Andro+
products.usage: Apply as directed by doctor to affected facial areas.
products.note: Anti-androgen topical formulation targeting androgen-sensitive facial follicles — reduce unwanted facial hair growth driven by PCOS androgen excess. Avoid in pregnancy or planning to conceive.

patientNormalizationEngine.description: Converts raw STEPS answers into a structured patient object for topical engine input

outputFields.scalp_condition: Deduplicated array of normalized scalp tokens: dandruff, itching, oily, dry, sensitive, psoriasis, inflammation, fungal, normal
outputFields.hair_issues: Derived from goal+cause+immunity text: hairfall, thinning, alopecia, grey hair, dandruff, fungal
outputFields.hormonal_issues: Derived from hormonal+thyroid text: pcos, thyroid, postpartum, menopause, pregnancy. Default 'none' if empty.
outputFields.is_pregnant: boolean — true if is_pregnant===true OR hormonal_issues includes 'pregnancy'
outputFields.planning_pregnancy: boolean — true if planning_pregnancy===true OR extra text includes conception intent phrases
outputFields.hasDandruffItchingCombo: boolean — true if any scalp answer has both 'dandruff' and 'itch' substrings
outputFields.hasPsoriasis: boolean — true if any scalp answer has 'psoriasis' substring

functions.name: _topicalProtocolConditionScore(rowKey, patient, answerText)

gym / high androgen — patient has gym/bodybuilding/androgen
plateau / no response — patient reports plateau/no response

recommendationEngine.description: Main topical recommendation engine. Builds recommended[] and caution[] arrays based on patient signals. Output capped at 6 recommended + 4 caution.

derivedPatientFlags.isDryDandruff: patient has dry/dandruff/itching OR ansText has frizzy/white flakes
derivedPatientFlags.isInflamed: patient has inflammation/sensitive OR ansText has psoriasis/redness
derivedPatientFlags.isDandruffItching: patient.hasDandruffItchingCombo OR (dandruff AND itching both in scalp_condition)
derivedPatientFlags.isPCOS: patient hormonal_issues has pcos OR ansText has pcod
derivedPatientFlags.isMeno: ansText has menopause OR post menopause — AND NOT isPeriMeno
derivedPatientFlags.hasFacialHair: ansText has facial hair / hirsut / fha / trichonourish

algorithm: Filter: row.gender must match patient.gender (skip mismatch)
Score: base 40 + age<18 bonus 12 (if applicable) + scalpScore + conditionScore + female hormonal bonus +10
Return { treatment, source: 'Recommended Treatment column', matchedRow: 'gender / age / grade / scalp / key' }

gradeBrackets.All Grades / any: always matches (gradeNum fallback 0 = no match unless 'all')

hiddenCouplings.description: AUTO_02 auto-inject reads S._conditionScores from the main clinical engine (matchProtocol() global state). This creates a runtime dependency between the topical engine and the kit protocol engine — topical F-Emugrow MCRD injection for pattern loss is gated on AGA scoring from the separate subsystem.
hiddenCouplings.risk: If matchProtocol() has not been called before recommendTopicals(), S._conditionScores is undefined and the auto-inject will not fire even when pattern loss is clinically present.

hiddenCouplings.description: F-Emugrow MCR (without D) is used for females <30 in psoriasis/dandruff branches — this is a DIFFERENT product from F-Emugrow MCRD (with D = Dutasteride). The database only contains MCRD. MCR variant is implied by age < 30 logic but not in TOPICAL_DATABASE.
hiddenCouplings.risk: Product catalog is incomplete — F-Emugrow MCR is referenced in recommendation output but has no database entry. Downstream rendering or PDF generation may fail to match ingredients/mechanism for this variant.

hiddenCouplings.description: recommendTopicals() reads patientInput.treatment or patientInput.treatments (both checked) to detect heat/chemical treatment history for F-Trichosilk auto-inject. These field names are not in the STEPS array — they are injected externally or via an undocumented intake pathway.
hiddenCouplings.risk: If treatment field is missing, noTreatment evaluates to !false = true → always recommends 'Without Treatment' variant even for patients with heat styling history.

hiddenCouplings.description: Hypertension early-return branch checks ansText for 'hypertension' / 'blood pressure' — but neither word appears as an option in any STEPS question. Signal can only arrive via free-text fields (extra, medical_detail). This means a structured intake can never activate this override; it only fires from unstructured text.
hiddenCouplings.risk: Hypertension-based Minoxidil contraindication will silently miss patients who select a checkbox-based medical condition. Dangerous in clinical context.

productsWithNoDBEntry: F-Emugrow MCR (variant of MCRD for females under 30)
clinicalArchitectureObservations: The topical engine is a fully separate clinical subsystem from the kit protocol engine — it runs independently on the same patient answers.

TOPICAL_PROTOCOL_ROWS represents a structured clinical lookup (sourced from spreadsheet) while recommendTopicals() is a rule-based override engine. Both run and the protocol row selector provides the single 'recommended treatment' string for the report header.

F-Emugrow MCRD appears as both a database product and an auto-inject rule (AUTO_02) — it can be added twice if the main branch also selects it. The output cap (slice(0,6)) prevents overflow but deduplication is not enforced.

The pregnancy and hypertension early-returns bypass all scoring — these are absolute contraindication gates identical in philosophy to the matchProtocol() absolute locks (ALOPECIA_AREATA at 105, TTM at 102).

The auto-inject F-Biwash+ rule is the topical engine's equivalent of the kit engine's PRO IMMUNE always-last rule — both enforce a mandatory product based on a specific condition flag regardless of other scoring outcomes.
